question: What disclosure and execution boundary should dashboard log-tail and command-output widgets follow before OpenClaw accepts bundled builtins for them?
rationale: The feature is plausible and aligned with dashboard ergonomics, but it exposes operational logs and command output in a new always-available UI context and overlaps open binding-security work.

options.title: Stage After Binding Review
options.body: Keep this issue open until the dashboard substrate and stream/command binding boundary are approved, then implement the widgets against those contracts.

options.title: Narrow To Read-Only Sources
options.body: Allow a focused implementation that only reads existing `logs.tail` and recorded command-output data, excluding new command execution or generic command bindings.

options.title: Defer Bundled Widgets
options.body: Leave this as roadmap context until maintainers sponsor bundled dashboard builtins or a plugin API extension makes an external package viable.

recommendation.title: Stage After Binding Review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the dashboard substrate and stream/command binding boundary are approved, then implement the widgets against those contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest merged-history signal across both the logs surface and the bundled Control UI tab seam this work would extend.
